title: Gleditsia sinensis perisperm ameliorates DSS-induced ulcerative colitis via the TLR4/NF-kappaB/NLRP3 signaling pathway: Safety evaluation and bioactive amino acid profiling.
authors: Yang, Zhongqin; Ding, Qin; Li, Jiaxin; Xu, Feng; Zhang, Yanyan; Wu, Hongmei; Wang, Xiangpei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究皂荚米通过TLR4/NF-kB/NLRP3通路缓解溃疡性结肠炎，属纯湿实验药理学研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Seeds of Gleditsia sinensis Lam. (Zaojiaozi) are traditionally used for intestinal wind hematochezia, dysentery and tenesmus, matching ulcerative colitis (UC) symptoms. Its processed perisperm product Zaojiao Mi (ZJM) may have similar anti-UC effects, yet this remains unclarified. AIM OF THE STUDY: UC is a chronic intestinal inflammation linked to immune dysregulation. While Zaojiaozi is used for UC, the anti-UC activity, active components, safety and mechanism of ZJM are unclear. This study systematically explored these aspects for its development and application. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Amino acid contents in ZJM were quantified and in vivo safety assessed. Enzyme-Linked Immunosorbent Assay (ELISA), Reverse Transcription-Polymerase Chain Reaction (RT-PCR) and relevant assays were used to measure inflammatory factors (IL-6, IL-1beta, TNF-alpha), gene expressions (TLR4, NF-kappaB p65, NLRP3, Caspase-1) and SCFA levels, together with their correlation analysis. RESULTS: This study identified 17 amino acids in ZJM. ZJM showed high oral safety with LD50 > 1.35 g/kg, and negative results in Ames, micronucleus, sperm abnormality and teratogenicity tests,it reduced fetal weight and length in a dose-dependent manner, while all developmental parameters remained within normal ranges without obvious pathological or functional abnormalities. Pharmacodynamic study results indicated that ZJM alleviated UC in mice by lowering the corresponding disease activity index, restoring colon length, and mitigating mucosal damage, downregulating IL-6, IL-1beta, and TNF-alpha, inhibiting the TLR4/NF-kappaB/NLRP3 pathway, while boosting SCFAs (butyrate/propionate negatively correlated with targets). Eleven amino acids (e.g., arginine) exhibited high affinity for pathway targets and correlated with UC targets. CONCLUSIONS: ZJM is safe and exerts anti-UC effects through anti-inflammation and pathway regulation. Eleven amino acids are potential active components, supporting its use in UC adjuvant intervention.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：皂荚（Gleditsia sinensis Lam.）种子（皂角子）传统上用于治疗肠风便血、痢疾和里急后重，与溃疡性结肠炎（UC）症状相符。其加工后的种皮产品皂角米（ZJM）可能具有类似的抗UC作用，但这一点尚未明确。研究目的：UC是一种与免疫失调相关的慢性肠道炎症。虽然皂角子用于治疗UC，但ZJM的抗UC活性、活性成分、安全性及机制尚不清楚。本研究系统探讨了这些方面，以促进其开发和应用。材料与方法：定量分析了ZJM中的氨基酸含量，并评估了体内安全性。采用酶联免疫吸附测定（ELISA）、逆转录聚合酶链反应（RT-PCR）及相关检测方法，测量炎症因子（IL-6、IL-1β、TNF-α）、基因表达（TLR4、NF-κB p65、NLRP3、Caspase-1）和短链脂肪酸（SCFA）水平，并进行相关性分析。结果：本研究在ZJM中鉴定出17种氨基酸。ZJM表现出较高的口服安全性，LD50 > 1.35 g/kg，且在Ames试验、微核试验、精子畸形试验和致畸试验中结果均为阴性，它以剂量依赖性方式降低胎儿体重和身长，但所有发育参数均保持在正常范围内，无明显病理或功能异常。药效学研究结果表明，ZJM通过降低相应疾病活动指数、恢复结肠长度、减轻黏膜损伤、下调IL-6、IL-1β和TNF-α、抑制TLR4/NF-κB/NLRP3通路，同时提升SCFA（丁酸盐/丙酸盐与靶标呈负相关）来缓解小鼠UC。11种氨基酸（如精氨酸）对通路靶标表现出高亲和力，并与UC靶标相关。结论：ZJM是安全的，并通过抗炎和通路调节发挥抗UC作用。11种氨基酸是潜在活性成分，支持其在UC辅助干预中的应用。
